metrics.name: marketListingsTotal
metrics.description: Total number of validated real-estate listings available in the analytical market dataset. This KPI measures the current volume of market observations available for real-estate intelligence and reporting.

metrics.name: averagePropertyPrice
metrics.description: Average advertised price of validated properties represented in the analytical market dataset. This KPI provides a high-level indicator of property market valuation.

metrics.name: averagePricePerM2
metrics.description: Average advertised property price per square metre across validated real-estate listings. This KPI enables normalized comparison of property values independently of property surface.

metrics.name: averagePropertySurface
metrics.description: Average surface area in square metres of validated properties represented in the analytical market dataset.

metrics.name: activeMandates
metrics.description: Number of real-estate search mandates currently considered active. This KPI represents the current operational portfolio of property searches handled by the real-estate service.

metrics.name: listingsByCity
metrics.description: Number of validated real-estate listings grouped by city. This KPI provides a geographical view of market inventory and supports comparison of listing volumes between local markets.

metrics.name: listingsByDpe
metrics.description: Number of validated real-estate listings grouped by energy performance classification. This KPI supports analysis of the energy-efficiency profile of the available property market.

metrics.name: listingsByPropertyType
metrics.description: Number of validated real-estate listings grouped by property type. This KPI describes the composition of market inventory across the different categories of properties.

metrics.name: listingsBySource
metrics.description: Number of validated real-estate listings grouped by acquisition source. This KPI provides visibility into the contribution of each data source to the analytical property market dataset.

metrics.name: propertiesWithSector
metrics.description: Current property dimension rows, excluding the unknown property member. Missing sectors are valid for standard generation; this measures coverage, not matching quality or generation mode.
metrics.expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current AND id_bien_source <> 0 AND secteur_key <> 0)

metrics.name: propertiesWithoutSector
metrics.description: Current property dimension rows, excluding the unknown property member. Missing sectors are valid for standard generation; this measures coverage, not matching quality or generation mode.
metrics.expression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current AND id_bien_source <> 0 AND secteur_key = 0)
